# Spec: Render a text template

[Specs](README.md) | [User guide](../user-guide/render-a-template.md)

**Start:** `/content/templates`  
**Persona:** A developer producing documents or email bodies from data  
**Goal:** Fill a template with JSON data and read the result.

**Table 1 — Acceptance criteria**

| Step | Action | Expected result |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 1 | See the supported template types | The supported types list is shown. |
| 2 | Apply the template | The rendered output appears under Output. |
